messages:
Maya: Ok team — planning a 90m roleplay session with a design partner to stress-test our beta SLA conversation. Goal: 1) surface confusing wording in the SLA, 2) validate fallback script when Dedicated capacity unavailable, 3) test feedback routing. Wed Apr 12 10:00 PT. @Samir @Aj @Lindsey (Sales) available?
Aj: I can make it. Suggest we run two scenarios: normal traffic and cold-start KV-cache miss. Keep roleplay 45/45 split for lead and follow-up notes.
Samir: +1. I'll bring the latency graphs and a short script to simulate bursty traffic (rps spike). Also want to confirm quantization tradeoffs explanation for sales.
Carmen: I'll pretend to be Head of Platform (fintech). My primary asks: data residency, audit logs, and rollback SLA. I'll push on pricing under heavy tails.
Lindsey (Sales): Perfect. I'll drive the discovery portion and capture exact language that resonated (or didn't) for a contract.
Maya: Proposed acceptance criteria for the roleplay: a) capture 3 ambiguous SLA phrases, b) produce alternative wording for customer-facing doc, c) validate fallback script runs <5m and automated rollback triggers at 10% error lift. Agree?
Aj: Agree. Also measure time to spin up Dedicated fallback in the run (scripted). We'll log commands we run.
ops-bot: calendar invite created: Roleplay — Beta SLA negotiation, Wed Apr 12 10:00 PT (90m). Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/roleplay-0424
Samir: For the roleplay script, propose these two snippets we can paste in meeting notes:

```markdown
Scenario A: 10k rps burst for 2m -> expect p95 < 800ms on Hosted, auto-route to Dedicated after 30s if sustained.
Scenario B: Cold KV-cache miss -> explain caching tradeoffs and expected token-cost differential.
``` 

Maya: Nice. Also need to rehears fallback messages for the customer. Drafting short templates:
- Customer-facing apology + mitigation plan (1–2 lines)
- Internal urgent slack to eng-oncall with backfill request (single command)

Aj: Example internal command we will run in roleplay: `./ops/fallback --route dedicated --until 10m --tag roleplay-test` — make sure it prints estimated cost delta.
Carmen: For feedback capture, let's use a 6-question micro-survey immediately after the session (time to first meaningful answer, clarity of SLA language, trust in rollback). I'll draft it.
Lindsey (Sales): We should also track whether legal requests more changes after the roleplay. Capture "deal blockers" field in notes.
Maya: Great. Action items:
- Aj: prepare fallback script + cost-print
- Samir: latency graphs + synthetic load scripts
- Carmen: micro-survey & role persona checklist
- Lindsey: discovery script + contract "must-haves"
I'll collect notes and propose SLA wording updates by EOD Thu. Thanks!
Lindsey (Sales): :thumbsup:
Samir: See you Wed.
Aj: Logging scripts to /handbooks/betas/roleplay-0424 (will attach after meeting).
